instructions: Compare the base and current text for one changed root section. Choose the single label whose criterion best describes the change. Use scope when the change adds, removes, or moves a capability, surface, or non-goal. Use behavioral when the result or a rule changes. Use clarification when behavior stays the same and wording becomes more precise. Use cosmetic when meaning stays the same and only wording, order, or style changes.

labels.name: scope
labels.description: Adds, removes, or moves a capability, surface, or non-goal.

input.after: Change type in Git focus and reading view.

input.before: The shared contract covers one pair.
input.after: The shared contract covers corpus, coverage, and audience pairs.

labels.name: behavioral
labels.description: Alters what the result does: a rule, interface, edge case, or criterion.

input.before: Fixture review cases The server retries once on timeout and keeps the original comment quote. This passage is deleted in the current head. The revised section does not yet enable retry. The revised section had the old cache rule. The draft only records a local note. As a reviewer, I need an entirely unrelated fixture outcome. The unrelated fixture outcome is observable.
input.after: Fixture review cases The server retries once on timeout and keeps the original comment quote. The revised section enables retry after a timeout and records the retry. The revised section changes only the display color of the badge. The draft automatically writes tracker updates now. As a reviewer, I need an entirely unrelated fixture outcome. The unrelated fixture outcome is observable.

labels.name: clarification
labels.description: Keeps the behavior the same while stating its meaning more precisely.

input.before: Each changed root section gets one change-type question.
input.after: Each changed root section gets one Choice question with scope, behavioral, clarification, and cosmetic criteria.

input.before: The seam follows the shared Jev contract.
input.after: The seam follows the current retry, cache, and no-reorder contract.

labels.name: cosmetic
labels.description: Changes wording, order, or style without changing meaning.

input.after: Fixture typo case The review server returns one suggestion round.
